about: What changed in each release, newest first. Before pushing to main, run npm run release-notes: it adds the subjects of the player-facing commits since the last release. Edit the lines freely, then commit this file with the release.

notes: Grow Quail Fields as Rolling Red Plains rangeland: red soil, copper bunchgrass, sand plum thickets and creek timber
Grow brush and trees from a shared woody kit of leafy lobes instead of faceted balls
Patch Sharptail prairie at every scale and grow its draws from the woody kit
Grow Chukar's big sage on gnarled trunks instead of grey stone clusters
Turn each ground through its year: green September hollows to January snow, rain, and frost that burns off
Give each ground the sound of its day: weather, the cover's voice and the season's birds
Let Chukar's river catch the sky, and give the canyon clearer air, cooler shade and a wall over the River Road
Let falls read at range, with a feather puff and a thump that arrives late
Mark a miss you watched go down, and press C to cast the dog to the mark
Mark a rooster by his sail into cover, and work the edge where he went in
Know the bird on a phone: readable size at range and a wingbeat you can see
Glide birds down into their landings instead of dropping them straight in
See birds before the flush, now and then: a rooster crossing the two-track, chukar running uphill, sharptails on a dawn skyline
Find sign on the ground near some coveys: roost rings, tracks, dusting bowls, a feather
Pour chukar down the canyon's own fall line, never back past the gun
End a chukar runner chase inside a minute and a half, and let the dog lead a hunter who follows it toward cover
Charge for the climb only on Chukar Ridge
Fly a covey again when it flushes the instant it lands, so the dog is never left marking an empty canyon
Stop the dog running through Quail's trees
Give the dog a loin: the back flexes through the stride and the dog leans into turns
Plant the dog's paws on the ground as it is drawn, hold the gallop through a turn, and never drag a paw
Mark the birds and the fall like a dog, brake at the bird, and keep the flag up through a pup's creep
Check, glance and wag like a dog, not a metronome
Dawn birds sit tight near the roost, and a low sun glares
Let a creeping pup be seen, and whoa'd, before it bumps the bird
Keep dog callouts off the dog they describe
Hold G to look closer at a distant dog
Put every dog in a blaze-orange field collar
Stop Quail and Chukar dogs circling cover they can never reach
Give phones the same colour as desktop, and fog that follows the sky
Bring back Duck Hunt waves: the covey thunders, three birds fly
Derive what grows where from the land itself
Fog the field in linear light so phones and desktop see the same air
Give each ground its own far air, a readable Sharptail evening and cold Cattail light
Put each region's own country on the horizon: no mountains on the plains
Keep dawn mist and canyon dusk in the low ground, and lay shelterbelts long and low
Grow Sharptail from the shared ground kit: knee-high shoulders, copper crowns, maroon swales
Close the tops of sward masses and thickets
Rebuild Chukar Ridge as a canyon you climb
Dome the core of a draw-head thicket so it never reads as a pit
Real far country with parallax, sky occlusion and wind-driven cloud shadows
Crisp Cattail days, cool Sharptail evening shade, last light without navy or mauve
Throw soft dust and straw over a flushing covey, sized to the covey
Fly every bird on one planned line, rise in short waves, and let misses be marked
Keep Chukar's hunting steady on the bigger ground
Keep sky occlusion gentle so draws read without turning gloomy
Keep Chukar's phone cost near the old ground's
Crown Castle Rock and the mesas with whole basalt rims
Drop a bird shot over the fence just inside it
Add training grounds and targeted career dog development
Add the Wirehaired Pointing Griffon in steel gray and brown
Show the game's version and what's new on the home screen
Stop the flashes of light on Chukar Ridge and Quail Fields
Hold pointed coveys and roosters until the hunter is close
Keep quail readable at range and burst a close covey wide
Give the guns weight, a ready carry and spent hulls
Deliver birds to hand, and show the dog's wake in Cattail cover
Move the setter onto the skinned rig and retire the articulated dog
Slam dogs into point and bound them through tall cover
Clear the tall stalks from the hunter's eye in Cattail cover
Mat the Quail Fields floor with dead grass and tussock the tufts
Give the Hun and the prairie chicken their own bodies
Give each ground its own light on top of Crisp
Render the menu art from the game
Anchor a hit bird with the second barrel; legs on every gamebird
Daily bag limits
Celebrate a pup's first point
An old dog's last season, and the porch
The tailgate photo
Save export and import
A real shotgun report and the guns' own mechanics
The birds of each ground, and the quarry's own voices
The dog's bell, breath and the handler's whistle
Footsteps on every ground, and the field through the day
A small score: the menu theme on guitar, and the hunt's last bars

Configure free Cloudflare hosting and document game updates
